correctness.rationale: The sharp upper bound is an exact positive linear combination of two point evaluations. The displayed candidate attains equality and factors into a positive scalar, \(x+1\), a square \(x+r\)^2\), and a quartic whose degree-five Bernstein coefficients on \([-1,1]\) are all strictly positive. Equality in the upper certificate plus the derivative condition at the interior contact reconstructs the unique coefficients. The standalone exact-arithmetic checker independently verifies all identities.

value.rationale: Sparse Carathéodory–Fejér constants are classical natural invariants of support geometry. The support \(H=\{3,7\}\) is structurally motivated by a fifth-root resonance where the two allowed higher harmonics coincide, producing a sharp two-contact dual certificate and an exact golden-ratio value. The result is an exact support evaluation with a complete equality case, not a numerical recomputation or arbitrary parameter slice.
